lines: 1. Shut Windows down from inside the guest (Start > Shut down) - do not power the VM off.
2. Take the snapshot with the VM powered off (no memory); name it for the date or the change.
3. Push it: the Horizon image push plan (horizon_push_base_vm W11-Gold, horizon_push_snapshot the new snapshot's name).
